lessons: Monthly Cycle: 4H timeframe to evaluate the week. Look for SSMT with previous week. High probability confluenced with 4H TPD (works without TPD as well).

Weekly Cycle: 1H timeframe to evaluate daily behavior. Look for SSMT between two days (Mon/Tue, Tue/Wed, Wed/Thu, Thu/Fri, Fri/Mon). High probability confluenced with 1H TPD (works without TPD as well).
Daily Cycle: 15M timeframe for session-level setups (London, NY AM, NY PM, Asia). Look for SSMT between sessions/quarters. High probability confluenced with 15M TPD (works without TPD as well).
90-Minute Cycle: 5M timeframe for 90-minute session/quarter focus. High probability confluenced with 5M TPD (works without TPD as well).
Universal Rule: SSMT is high probability when confluenced with TPD, but SMT setups execute and work without TPD across all cycles and timeframes.
